info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Agent Wellbeing API

items.docs: This endpoint provides real-time burnout events that are generated for agents belonging to the organization. It gives us a WebSocket URL to which we can connect to receive the real-time burnout events.
The endpoint need to be invoked by Partners and Third-Party that will subscribe to the Agent Burnout system, in order to take certain action based on the agent burnout index calculated.
